title: Tank Brigade
author: cobanov
description: Guard your energy core in a top-down tank battle: blast through brick walls, grab power-ups from flashing tanks and hold out against twenty enemy tanks on each of ten stages.

controls.D-pad: Drive (on the title: choose a stage)
controls.A: Fire (hold for auto fire); start / play again
controls.B: Back to title (paused or game over)
